notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for the IEEE 1516.1-2025 empty-specification interaction-region boundary. The source uses only official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOMs, endpoint, and callback configuration. It retains the excluded-dimension non-overlap case and separately checks that an empty region specification realizes an available interaction dimension's FOM default range by contrasting disjoint and overlapping regional subscriptions. It does not claim behavior for nonavailable dimensions or all default/excluded-indicator combinations. No provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior are required.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador interaction publication, ordinary and regional subscriptions, zero-dimensional region creation and commit, Set Range Bounds, ordinary and regional interaction send, unsubscribe, region cleanup, and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador zero-dimensional regional interaction declarations
tests: cpp/tests/zero_dimensional_regional_interaction_catch2.cpp::Embedded empty interaction regions realize available FOM default ranges
